## The papers family {#papers}

<p class="section-lead">Three apps over the same plain files: your BibTeX library and its PDFs, and the folder of
each paper. Each works on its own; together they follow a paper from the first sight of it to the review of
someone else's.</p>

::: {#papers-apps}
:::

## Working together {#together}

<p class="section-lead">Science is done in groups, and groups need to talk: about drafts, figures and model runs,
with the equations in the message.</p>

::: {#together-apps}
:::

## Under the hood {#under-the-hood}

<p class="section-lead">The libraries the apps are built on, open source as well.</p>

::: {.blocks}

::: {.block}
### [papers](https://github.com/perrette/papers)
The command line that started it: a bibliography of PDFs and BibTeX, managed from the terminal. The apps keep
its files and follow its behaviour.
:::

::: {.block}
### [papers-rs](https://github.com/mathesislab/papers-rs)
A Rust port of papers, with its command line, and a port of pylatexenc. The three papers apps read and write
your library with it.
:::

::: {.block}
### [tauri-plugin-pdfkit](https://github.com/mathesislab/tauri-plugin-pdfkit)
A PDF in a native PDFKit view, as Preview shows it, over part of a Tauri window on macOS. It shows the PDFs in
the three papers apps.
:::

:::

:::
